name: Infantry_Runners
author: Infantry AI

actions.label: Add a runner from its link, check, pause, resume, detach or rotate one

description: Runners settings card (RUNNER-POOL-9, RUNNER-ADD-UI-1): the runner pool's settings in one place. The heading and the Add runner button always show, so a runner is paired from here by pasting the link it prints (RUNNER-ADD-LINK-1) with no terminal; a successful add runs the health check (RUNNER-CHECK-1) and shows its rows with the fix under each failure. While runners.enabled is off the rest of the card (default placement, per-runner worker caps, heartbeat) stays hidden. Pausing, detaching, rotating and checking go through the same `runner_admin` frame as `infantry runner ...`.

config.title: Runners
config.applies: Applies to: where ticket workers run. Off = every worker runs on this machine, as before.

fields.label: Use runners
fields.description: Off = every worker runs on this machine and this card shows nothing else.

fields.label: Default placement
fields.description: Where a ticket with no pin and no routing rule starts. `any` picks the runner that is up, has the project and harness, and has the most free slots (ties go to local); it waits when none is free.

fields.label: Local worker cap
fields.description: Most workers this machine runs at once, under the global worker cap. Other runners: set runners.<name>.maxWorkers.
